acceptance_criteria.criterion: All new CSS classes are defined and style the dialogue elements as described in the plan.
.dialogue-tool-toggle has cursor: pointer, no background, full-width, left-aligned styling.
.dialogue-tool-args has max-height: 300px, overflow-y: auto for large JSON payloads.
.dialogue-tool-result has a left border accent and lighter background.
All colours use var(--color-*) custom properties — no hardcoded colour values.
Dark mode renders correctly via [data-theme="dark"] overrides.

summary: Added 11 new CSS classes to mcp-server/gui/public/styles.css for the interactive dialogue view

Classes cover all dialogue element types: text, tool-call container, toggle button, expand arrow, details body, detail lines, args display, embedded result, result label, checklist, and subagent heading
All colours use var(--color-*) custom properties only — zero hardcoded hex values
Dark mode overrides added via [data-theme="dark"] for all classes that require distinct dark treatment
3377 total tests pass; TypeScript compiles cleanly

comments.note: styles.css: The new `.dialogue-tool-toggle:hover` uses `color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 4%, transparent)` for the hover state. This reuses the same `color-mix()` pattern already present elsewhere in the file so browser support is consistent.

comments.note: styles.css: `overflow-y: auto` on `.dialogue-tool-args` implicitly sets `overflow-x: auto` per the CSS spec (overflow axes cannot independently be visible+non-visible). Horizontal scrolling on long JSON lines is therefore correctly handled — no explicit `overflow-x: auto` is needed.
